verbatim: Amtagvi will be sold in the U.S. at a list price of $515,000 per patient, interim CEO Frederick Vogt said on a conference call.
source_doc: Reuters (2024-02-17), as shown in Brave search results; corroborated by Fierce Pharma (2024-02-20): 'Iovance prices Amtagvi ... at a wholesale acquisition cost of $515,000 per patient', BioPharma Dive (2024-02-20) and NCI Cancer Currents ('According to the company, a single treatment with lifileucel will cost $515,000')
notes: WAC of the Amtagvi product only; excludes lymphodepletion, Proleukin (IL-2), hospitalisation and ATC fees. Stated by Iovance on its approval-day call (2024-02-16); none of the eight Iovance 8-K earnings exhibits read for this batch states the price. Article URLs not captured from the results page.

verbatim: Onboarding is complete at more than 40 U.S. ATCs
source_doc: Iovance 8-K Ex-99.1, First Quarter 2024 Financial Results and Corporate Updates (2024-05-09)
notes: Floor ('more than 40'). Release adds expectations of approximately 50 ATCs by end of May 2024 and more than 70 by end of 2024.

verbatim: more than 100 patients have enrolled for Amtagvi therapy
source_doc: Iovance 8-K Ex-99.1, First Quarter 2024 Financial Results and Corporate Updates (2024-05-09)
notes: Enrolment (treatment initiated/scheduled), not infusion; floor. First commercial infusion occurred in April 2024.

verbatim: approximately 34 days from inbound to return shipment to ATCs
source_doc: Iovance 8-K Ex-99.1, First Quarter 2024 Financial Results and Corporate Updates (2024-05-09)
notes: Manufacturing turnaround at launch; by Aug 2026 stated as '31 days or less'.

verbatim: Amtagvi launch, with revenue recognized upon patient infusion
source_doc: Iovance 8-K Ex-99.1, Third Quarter and Year to Date 2024 Financial Results (2024-11-07)
notes: KEY: Amtagvi revenue is recognised on infusion, so quarterly revenue divided by net price approximates patients infused in the quarter. Same release: 'Proleukin revenue is recognized upon delivery to distributors and ATCs'. Reiterated in the Q4 2024 release: 'Amtagvi revenue is recognized upon patient infusion'.

verbatim: A total of 146 patients have been infused with Amtagvi since the first commercial infusion in April 2024
source_doc: Iovance 8-K Ex-99.1, Third Quarter and Year to Date 2024 Financial Results (2024-11-07)
notes: As of the release date (2024-11-07), not quarter end. Cross-check: Amtagvi revenue through 2024-09-30 was 54.9 (about 110-120 patients at 465-500k net per patient), so 146 by early November is consistent.

verbatim: Onboarding is complete at 56 U.S. ATCs across 29 states
source_doc: Iovance 8-K Ex-99.1, Third Quarter and Year to Date 2024 Financial Results (2024-11-07)

verbatim: Approximately 70 U.S. ATCs are active across 32 states
source_doc: Iovance 8-K Ex-99.1, Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2024 Financial Results (2025-02-27)
notes: Approximate. Same release: '64% infused one or more patients, and 13% infused more than 10 patients' (share of ATCs). Also: 'A total of 15 active ATCs are targeted by year-end to support initial launch' (ex-US, Canada/UK).

verbatim: Total product revenue guidance within the range of $450 to $475 million for 2025
source_doc: Iovance 8-K Ex-99.1, Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2024 Financial Results (2025-02-27)
notes: Guidance later cut: Aug 2025 and Nov 2025 releases reiterate 'within the range of $250 to $300 million in the first full calendar year of Amtagvi sales'. Actual FY2025 total product revenue ~264.

verbatim: Product revenue from U.S. Amtagvi sales was $54.1 million, representing 102 commercial patients treated.
source_doc: Iovance 8-K Ex-99.1, Second Quarter and First Half 2025 Financial Results (2025-08-07)
notes: KEY calibration point: 54.1 / 102 = 0.530 million net revenue per patient in Q2 2025 (above the 2024 WAC of 0.515, implying a WAC increase before Q2 2025).

verbatim: The Amtagvi treatment network includes more than 80 U.S. ATCs across 35 states and 95% of addressable patients live within 200 miles of an ATC.
source_doc: Iovance 8-K Ex-99.1, Second Quarter and First Half 2025 Financial Results (2025-08-07)

verbatim: Health Canada is expected to approve Amtagvi monotherapy in the coming weeks
source_doc: Iovance 8-K Ex-99.1, Second Quarter and First Half 2025 Financial Results (2025-08-07)
notes: Q3 2025 release: 'In August 2025, Health Canada granted the first Amtagvi approval outside the U.S. for patients with previously treated advanced melanoma.' Q4 2025 release: 'Amtagvi was approved in Canada in August 2025.' UK review targeted H1 2026.

verbatim: More than 80 U.S. authorized treatment centers (ATCs) have been activated across nearly 40 states, providing a broad network within a two-hour drive for ~95% of Amtagvi patients.
Demand and referral patterns are accelerating across a growing network of more than 90 U.S. and Canadian authorized treatment centers (ATCs).
Total product revenue guidance for 2Q26 is $86 million to $88 million and for FY26 is $350 million to $370 million.
notes: Q2 2026 actual total product revenue 99.3 beat the range; Aug 2026 release: 'Iovance is reviewing its FY26 total revenue guidance of $350 million to $370 million. An update will be provided during the third quarter.'

verbatim: The network has grown to more than 95 U.S., Canadian, and Australian ATCs, with at least 110 ATCs expected to be active by the end of 2026.
notes: Floor. Same release: 'The marketing authorization application (MAA) for Amtagvi in Australia was approved by the Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA).' and 'Amtagvi turnaround time is 31 days or less'.

From Q3 2025 onward the releases stop giving patient counts; the last explicit counts are 146 cumulative infused (2024-11-07) and 102 treated in Q2 2025. Patient numbers for later quarters must be derived from revenue divided by net price per patient.
